Name: AT Cat Paintings
Author: EnbyFelix
Description:
Retextures of the painting 'Jade Hills'  rug to match my Portal Cats and Farm Portal Cat mods, plus more! There are 200 variations. If you want to have more than one of them, you can download this lovely mod by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/116553368]Atra[/url]: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12598]Museum Store[/url].

Added textures to match the RSV and Scarp Obelisks I added in the new Portal Cat update.
(thank you [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/24986819]Gervig91[/url] for letting me use your pelican assets and thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/66167516]Rafseazz[/url] for letting me use the Foxbloom.)

Added textures for my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11419]Stardrop Flower[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12274]Mini Stardrop Flower[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12704]Stardrop Bloom[/url].

Added a texture that matches the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8587]Zuzu[/url] Obelisk I added! Thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/111722573]XxHarvzBackxX[/url] for letting me use your Zuzu Signature Cocktail.

Added a texture that matches the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2571]DeepWoods [/url]obelisk I added!
